race.comment: LAVERS GINNY (1) quickly into stride to win over the 300m at this track two runs back then prominent throughout when finishing third at this track last start. Can find winning form. ZIPPING GLINDA (6) doesn't have the best strike-rate. Finished in the money last time though when second (17.45) at this track. Leading chance. MONTY'S RETURN (2) comes off an average run last start when seventh at Warragul over 400m behind Spring Queue (24.39) in a Grade 5. Has ability and can atone. DISTORTED HUMOUR (5) was unplaced here last start but gets his chance to atone.
